column1: # Regenerated 2026-08-07, for two snapshot-shape changes with no simulation change behind them:
#  - the Soul-of-Zinglon pillar render request (zinglonPillarActive/CX/Temp) became one per ship,
#    so three registry scalars became three two-element arrays. Verified by registering only
#    element [0] of each under its old name and size, every other change kept: all three hashes
#    and the layout hash came back identical to the previous line.
#  - JE_SingleEnemyType gained homeTarget (endless co-op homing). It lands in existing padding, so
#    sizeof and the layout hash do not move, but the fields after it shift a byte and demo 1's
#    hashed state moves with them. Verified by building with the field declared and never
#    assigned: demo 1 still hashes dbd7383e, so the shift alone accounts for it.
